summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for July 2026, furnishing a NI 43-101 technical report for the Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal. The report, prepared by company officers and a consultant, provides an update on mineral resources, reserves, and project economics. No corporate transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is named; this is a routine disclosure to keep the market informed on project advancement. There are no deal terms, tender offers, or special situation events. The filing is a normal periodic update, not a special situation.
